text: 站在原地，用右手在肩膀旁轻轻挥一下，然后自然放下。
english: A person stands in place, briefly waves once with the right hand beside the shoulder, then naturally lowers the arm.
expectation: 单手简单手势，观察抬手、挥动、放下是否自然连贯。

text: 站在原地，轻轻点一次头表示同意，然后恢复自然站姿。
english: A person stands in place, gently nods once in agreement, then returns to a relaxed upright posture.
expectation: 头颈与躯干的小幅配合，无多余迈步或大幅摆动。

text: 站在原地，用左手指向身体左前方，短暂停顿后放下手。
english: A person stands in place, points with the left arm diagonally forward to their own left, briefly pauses, then lowers the arm.
expectation: 方向清晰，动作有起止，肩肘衔接自然；不评手指。

text: 站在原地，双手慢慢向两侧摊开，掌心向上，同时轻轻耸肩表示疑问，停一下再放下。
english: A person stands in place, slowly opens both hands to the sides with palms upward while gently shrugging in a questioning gesture, pauses, then lowers both arms.
expectation: 双臂与肩部协调、停顿与恢复；位置输出的掌心扭转可能不支持。

text: 站在原地，右手放到胸前，上身微微前倾致意，然后站直并把手放下。
english: A person stands in place, brings the right hand in front of the chest, gently bows the upper body in greeting, then straightens up and lowers the hand.
expectation: 手部准备、躯干前倾、恢复有合理顺序，不要求精确触碰胸口。

text: 双脚留在原地，慢慢浅蹲，双臂自然向前保持平衡，然后平滑站起来并放松双臂。
english: Keeping both feet planted, a person slowly makes a shallow squat, bringing both arms naturally forward for balance, then smoothly stands up and relaxes the arms.
expectation: 骨盆、膝盖与双臂配合，脚部稳定，起身无突跳。

text: 站在原地，先用右手在头旁挥两下打招呼，放下右手，再双手摊开做解释，最后收回双手并轻轻点头。
english: A person stands in place, first waves twice with the right hand beside the head in greeting and lowers it, then opens both hands in an explanatory gesture, finally lowers both hands and gently nods.
expectation: 多个动作按顺序完成，过渡自然，不能只反复挥手。

text: 站在原地，先转头看向左侧，用左手指向左前方，停顿后收回手并看回前方，接着微微鞠躬，最后站直。
english: A person stands in place, first turns the head to the left and points diagonally forward-left with the left arm, pauses, lowers the arm and looks forward again, then gives a small bow and finally stands upright.
expectation: 头、手与躯干顺序配合，能回到前方和自然站姿。

text: 双脚留在原地，先浅蹲并把双臂伸到前方保持平衡，再缓慢站起，随后双手向两侧摊开，停顿后自然放下。
english: Keeping both feet planted, a person first makes a shallow squat with both arms extended forward for balance, slowly stands up, then opens both hands to the sides, pauses, and naturally lowers both arms.
expectation: 下肢动作与上肢表达分阶段衔接，观察接续突变和脚滑。
